learning: English, Tamil, Hindi, and Lucida Handwriting
Scientific methods and personalized error correction

courses.title: Creative Arts & Crafts

courses.title: Vedic Maths

courses.intro: Professional teacher training in Montessori philosophy, methods, and classroom management.

Individualized Learning: Tailored to each child's pace and interests

Use of play-based and experiential learning
Observation and assessment of young children
